description:
List delegated subagent spend keys (sbd_*) with caps, route allowlists, expiration, and live spend usage. Use this to audit subagent keys or check the 50-active-key limit without loading orders; do not use for full account state (x402_get_account) or reconciliation (x402_export_statement).
Parameters: supply spend_key or x-atlas-spend-key header (mismatch -> HTTP 400); master sees all keys, delegate sees only itself.
Behavior: zero charge; returns one unpaginated list sorted newest-first (up to 50 active plus history), HTTP 401 invalid/revoked key, 120 req/min/IP.

spend_key.description: Stripe-funded master or delegated subagent spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Optional when the caller supplies the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

status.description: Optional lifecycle status filter: "all" (default, every key), "active" (non-revoked and unexpired), "revoked", or "expired".

name: x402_list_delegate_keys

account_id.description: Account identifier owning the delegated keys.

active_count.description: Count of currently active (non-revoked, unexpired) delegated keys.

delegates.description: Delegated subagent key records with policy caps and real-time spend usage.

key_role.description: Authority tier of the caller key.

ok.description: True when the delegated keys listing succeeded.

returned_count.description: Number of delegated keys returned after applying any status filter.

total_count.description: Total delegated keys recorded on the account across all statuses.

title: List Delegated Subagent Keys
